item.title: 🟠 Chainalysis Confirms Intrusion Into Internal Tools and Exposure of Customer Identity Data
item.description:
Why this matters: Credential/phishing risk — reinforce MFA and watch for suspicious sign-ins.
American blockchain analysis firm Chainalysis said it was the target of a cybersecurity incident in which an external actor accessed non-sensitive customer data. However, the company noted that the breach did not result in unauthorized access to its investigation content, authentication credentials, or session tokens.
